content: Maria iliŋ ŋgere kuziiniŋana ise Yesu kumbuunu
Aigule lamata mi ta imbotmbot, tonabe lupŋana biibi ki Pasoba ipet. Mi Yesu ila ipet kar Betania. Kar tana ki Lasarus, tomtom ta Yesu ipei i ma imaŋga mini pa naala na.
Tana Yesu ziŋan naŋgaŋ kini tila tipet, mi kar tana tikam kini pini. Lasarus ziŋan Yesu bizin tikanan kini na, Mata ni imbotmbot mi irre zin pa kan koroŋ.
Tikanan ma timbotmbot, mi Maria ikam ŋgere kuziiniŋana ta ka kadoono biibi kat, ma iliŋ se Yesu kumbuunu, mi imus pa ute ruunu. Mi ŋgere tana kuziini irao ruumu leleene.
Tamen Yudas Iskariot, naŋgaŋ ki Yesu ta kaimer iuri la ka koi bizin naman na, imaŋga mi iso:
“Waii, pasaana sorok ŋgere tana paso! Kozobe imbot ma tala toŋgomoono, so takam pat ta sorok som kat. Irao kembei 300 denari ma iŋgi. Tona tu'uulu zin wal sorrokŋan pa.”
Sua tana, ni iso raama leleene som. Pa ni ikamam ŋgar pizin wal sorrokŋan som. Ni tomtom kuumbuŋana. Mi imborro kautu kizin, tanata ikamam bekena itunu ikamam pakaana.
To Yesu iso pini: “Wa, mbuulu sua pini pepe. Sombe ni leleene be ikam mbulu ti pio, na mbot mi ikam. Pa iŋgi ikam pataaŋa pa koŋ mete.
Zin wal sorrokŋan ko niomŋan kombotmbot totomen. Mi nio na som.”
Zin iwal biibi tileŋ kembei Yesu imbotmbot kar Betania, to timeke ma tila be tire i. Mi tiso tire Lasarus tomini. Pa Yesu ipei i ma burup ma imaŋga mini pa naala tau.
To zin bibip kizin patoronŋana kan timbuk sua be tipun Lasarus ma imeete tomini.
Pa Yuda boozo ta tileŋ Lasarus uruunu mi tire kat i na, tizem zin bibip tana, mi tiur lelen ila ki Yesu.
Yesu isala pa Yerusalem
Timbot ma aigule toro to, zin iwal biibi ta tila timbotmbot Yerusalem pa lupŋana biibi tana na, tileŋ Yesu uruunu be isala pa Yerusalem.
Tana tikam ni runrun, mi tila be tire i mi tiloolo pini. Tiso:

content.text: Merere ko ipombol tomtom taiŋgi. Pa ni ikam Merere ruŋguunu ta imar i.
Merere ko ikampe king kiti Israel!”

content: To Yesu ikam doŋki popoŋana ta ma mbuleene ise, mi ipa ma isala pa Yerusalem. Tabe sua ki Merere ta muŋgu tibeede se ro na, iur ŋonoono. Sua ta kembei:

content.text: Ni mbuleene ise doŋki popoŋana ma ima i.

content: Mbulu tana ipet na, zin naŋgaŋ ki Yesu tikankaana pa ka uunu. Tamen kaimer indeeŋe tau ni imeete mi isala mini pa saamba ma ikam zaana biibi, to matan iŋgal mbulu boozomen ta tikam pini na, mi tikilaala kembei sua tana, tibeede pini tau.

Uunu ta iwal biibi tana tila ma tire Yesu na, ta kembei: Indeeŋe tau ni ipei Lasarus ma imaŋga mini pa naala na, iwal biibi ta ziŋan tiwwa na, timbot mi tire mos tana. Tana tila mi tipombol ka sua pizin tomtom boozomen ma tileŋ.
Beso zin tutu kan tire zin iwal biibi tana ziŋan Yesu tiwwa mi tiloloolo pini na, tiparso pizin ma tiso: “Wai! Iŋgi ko takam ma som. Pa iwal munŋaana men, ta timap ma titop la kini kek.”
Zin Grik pakan tisombe tire Yesu
Zin Grik pakan tisala ma timbot Yerusalem pa lupŋana biibi tana tomini.
Tana tila ki Pilip, (ni kar kini Betsaida ta imbot Galilea na), mi tiso pini: “Biibi, niam leleyam be amre Yesu.”
Tana Pilip ila ma iso pa Andreas, mi ziru tila ma tiso pa Yesu.
Mi Yesu ipekel kwon ma iso: “Nol tabe Tomtom Lutuunu iswe kat mburaana mi mbulu kini ndabokŋana mi ikam zaana biibi, ta iŋgi imar ipet kek.

Nio aŋso kat piom: Kini iweene sa, sombe isula toono som, nako indom ma ise be parei? Som. Ko imbot sorok. Mi sombe isula toono, nako popoŋana indom ma ise, mi iur ŋonoono boozo. Pa bela kini iweene tana isula toono, tona ipiyooto popoŋana.
Tomtom ta sombe ikam ŋgar biibi mete pa itunu kuliini isu toono, inako ila lene. Mi tomtom ta sombe ikam ŋgar pa itunu som, nako ikam mbotŋana ki Anutu ta irao imap na som.
Tomtom ta so imbeeze pio, na bela ito yo. Naso lele tabe nio aŋla mi aŋbot pa i, na ni tomini ko imbot pa. Mi tomtom ta sombe imbesmbeeze pio, na Tamaŋ ko ipakuri.
Yesu iso pa meeteŋana kini
“Nio leleŋ ipata biibi kat. Pa iŋgi nol tio ipet kek. Mi ko aŋso parei? Ko aŋso: ‘Oo Tamaŋ, tatke yo pa pataŋana biibi ti.’ E-e, kembena pepe. Pa uunu tina ta aŋsu toono.
O Tamaŋ, swe mburom mi mbulu ku ndabokŋana pizin tomtom. Naso tipakur nu zom!” Yesu iso sua tana, to Anutu kalŋaana ta imbot saamba mi isu. Iso: “Nio aŋswe ituŋ pizin tomtom kek, mi kola aŋswe mini.”
Zin iwal ta ziŋan timbotmbot mi tileŋ sua tana na, pakan tiso lele ikuruŋ. Mi pakan tiso: “A! Iŋga ko aŋela sa ta iso sua pini na.”
Tamen Yesu iso pizin: “Sua ta niom keleŋ na, isu be iuulu yo na som. Inabe iuulu yom.
Iŋgi be Anutu iswe kat sanaana kizin tomtom toono kan, mi iur kadoono pa. Mi iŋgi be iziiri ni ta ikamam peeze pa toono ti ma ila ne.
Iŋgi nio aŋbotmbot su toono. Mi kaimer sombe tiwit yo ma aŋsala kor, tona nio ko aŋyaaru tomtom ta boozomen ma timar tio.”
Sua tana, ni iso bekena iswe zaala tabe imeete pa i.

Zin iwal tileŋ sua kini tana, to tipekel kwoono ma tiso: “Sua ta imbot la tutu kiti na, iso ta kembei: Mesia ko imbotmbot ma alok. Kena parei ta nu so Tomtom Lutuunu, bela tiwiti ma isala kor? Tomtom Lutuunu tana, ni asiŋ?”

To Yesu iso pizin. Iso: “Molo som, to mat izem yom. Tana mat imbotmbot ta kembei, mi kapa pa mi kakamam ka mbulu pataaŋa. Kere: Kokena zugut mburaana ikoto yom. Pa tomtom ta sombe iwwa pa zugut leleene, inako ikankaana pa zaala tabe ila pa i.
Tana mat iyaryaara ta kembei mi kuurla kini pataaŋa. Naso kewe mat lutuunu bizin.” Yesu iso sua tana makiŋ, to izem zin, mi ila ma ike pizin.
Zooroŋana kizin Yuda
Ŋonoono, Yesu itooro mos boozomen ma zin Yuda tire. Tamen tiurla kini som.
Tabe sua ta muŋgu Anutu kwoono Yesaya ibeede na, iur ŋonoono. Sua ta kembei:

content.text: O Merere, niam amkam sua ku pizin na zin tiurla? Som.
Mi nu swe mburom pizin na, tikam ŋgar pa? Som.

content: Mi Yesaya iso iti pa uunu tau zin tiurla som. Pa iso ta kembei:

content.text: Anutu ni ipumun matan mi isekaala ŋgar kizin kek.
Tanata matan imun mi ŋgar kizin ipet som.
Uunu tina ta titooro lelen som,
mi lelen be timar tio mi aŋurpe zin som.

content: Sua tana, Yesaya iso paso, muŋgu kat ire la pa mbulu mi uraata ki Yesu tabe zaana iwe biibi pa i. Tanata iso sua tana pini.
Indeeŋe tana, zin peeze kan kizin Yuda tomini, tomtom kizin boozo tiurla ki Yesu. Tamen tiswe urlaŋana kizin ma ipet mat som. Paso, timototo zin tutu kan: Kokena tiziiri zin pa lupŋana kizin.
Tana zin lelen ilip pa pakurŋana kizin tomtom. Mi pakurŋana ŋonoono ta imar pa Anutu na, tikam ŋgar pa pe som.
Yesu ipemet sua pizin iwal biibi
Yesu imaŋga mi kalŋaana biibi ma iso: “Tomtom ta sombe iurla tio, na iurla tio men som. Ina ni iurla ki Ni ta iŋgo yo ma aŋmar i tomini.
Mi tomtom ta sombe ire yo, ina ire Ni ta iŋgo yo ma aŋmar i tomini.
Nio aŋsu toono be aŋur mat pizin tomtom. Tana zin wal ta sombe tiurla tio, na tasa ko imbot la zugut lene mini som.

“Mi sombe tomtom sa ileŋleŋ sorok sua tio, mi itoto som, ina nio ituŋ ko aŋpamenderi mi aŋur kadoono pini na som. Pa aŋsu toono be aŋtiiri zin tomtom mi aŋur kadoono pizin na som. Aŋmar be aŋkamke zin.
Mi motoyom iŋgal! Tomtom ta sombe ipizil ndemeene pio mi izooro sua tio, inako ire ka kadoono pa mbeŋ kaimer. Pa sua ta aŋso na, ko iwe uunu pini be ikam kadoono tana.
Pa sua ta aŋkam piom na, ituŋ leleŋ mi aŋso som. Tamaŋ ta iŋgo yo ma aŋmar i, ni izzo pio ta aŋso.
Mi nio aŋute: Sua kini ta ni iur, ina ta iwe zaala pizin tomtom be tikam mbotŋana ki Anutu ta iseeŋge iseeŋge ma ila. Tana sua ta aŋso, ina Tamaŋ iso yo pa ta aŋso.”

footnotes.text: Ni ta ikamam peeze pa toono, ina Sadan tau. Mi indeeŋe Yesu imeete mi imaŋga mini pa naala na, ipunmeete Sadan mburaana.
